column1: # Original WritingDeck plots; MIT to the extent rights subsist; AI-assisted original drafting.
# stable_id|category|genres|premise

wd-p-1002|performance|realist,adventure|During a live, uninterrupted theater scene, a stagehand notices that a suspended prop is slipping. The only performer close enough to secure it must recognize a warning disguised as part of the dialogue.

wd-p-1003|consent|realist,mystery|Inside a soundproof archive room, two researchers discover that their entry permission covers different collections. A lock countdown begins, and one must show the other why the obvious exit would seal the evidence they came to examine.

wd-p-1004|coordination|realist,adventure|A string quartet must finish a live piece while a loose cable obstructs the only aisle to an audience member needing help. Breaking formation would draw a crowd into the blocked passage.

wd-p-1005|attention|realist,romance|At a farewell ceremony where they must remain silent, two former partners discover that each brought the object the other had asked to keep. Returning either object now would be visible to families who believe the separation was resolved.

wd-p-1006|proof|mystery,realist|A witness watching a single continuous security feed sees the same parcel carried through two doors. Stopping playback would erase the temporary buffer, while the person beside her keeps insisting on reviewing an earlier moment.

wd-p-1007|route|speculative,adventure|Two travelers can cross a narrow living bridge only while maintaining eye contact. A shifting branch blocks their view, and the person who can see a safe adjustment cannot point it out without turning away.

wd-p-1008|recognition|realist,family|During one formal photograph, an adult child realizes that an estranged parent has been placed outside the frame. Everyone has been told to stay still, and correcting the arrangement would require acknowledging the exclusion before the shutter opens.

wd-p-1009|threshold|realist,adventure|A boat approaches a low arch with a mast that can be lowered only while its sail is slack. A sudden gust arrives before the crew's agreed hand signals can be completed.

wd-p-1010|interpretation|realist,mystery|In a quiet examination room, an archivist must communicate that a document is being placed into the wrong protective sleeve. Speaking would contaminate a sound-sensitive test, but the assistant interprets every gesture as permission to proceed.

wd-p-1011|choice|realist,romance|At an auction, two partners discover they are bidding against each other through separate agents. Signaling cooperation would expose a private plan to the room, while waiting for the next lot may make the purchase irreversible.

wd-p-1012|causality|speculative,mystery|A town's clocks run normally except during acts of deliberate kindness. An investigator reconstructing a missing hour must identify who helped someone without asking any witness to turn the gift into evidence of virtue.

wd-p-1013|learning|realist,adventure|A novice fencer realizes that an opponent has mistaken a safety demonstration for the beginning of a match. The referee's view is blocked, and stopping safely requires a signal the novice has only practiced while standing still.

wd-p-1014|ownership|realist,family|A family shares access to a storage room but assigns each object to whoever can explain its use. A grandchild identifies a tool the adults dismissed as scrap, unsettling the assumption that knowledge follows age and inheritance.

wd-p-1015|resources|speculative,political|A settlement receives supplies according to the shortages it predicted accurately last year. A planner discovers that honest uncertainty reduces the award, while confident exaggeration produces enough surplus to appear prepared the following season.

wd-p-1016|repair|realist,romance|Two former partners meet to dismantle a piece of furniture they built together. An improvised joint can be separated only by remembering the sequence of a day they have each described differently since the separation.

wd-p-1017|sequence|mystery,realist|A historian finds that an interview transcript groups answers by subject rather than conversation order. Restoring the original sequence changes a confident denial into a response to a different question asked much later.

wd-p-1018|access|realist,political|A city creates a free public workspace that requires a current employer's confirmation. A job seeker challenges the rule and is offered a temporary pass that expires before the application process the workspace was meant to support.

wd-p-1019|identity|speculative,family|A family passes a storytelling role to whoever remembers the most details. A newcomer notices that the winning stories include facts supplied by everyone else, turning a contest of memory into a question of who is allowed to assemble shared experience.

wd-p-1020|coordination|realist,adventure|A cycling marshal must stop a race because a moveable bridge is opening. The stop signal is hidden by an advertising banner installed that morning, and the lead rider has been trained never to brake at that point.

wd-p-1021|value|realist,satire|A venue prices tickets according to how difficult the audience believes the performance will be. A skilled performer makes the work look effortless and earns less each time the act becomes safer through practice.

wd-p-1022|consent|speculative,romance|Two people exchange the ability to recognize each other's distress without knowing its cause. One asks for the ability back during an ordinary disagreement, and the other must decide whether returning it means refusing care or respecting a boundary.

wd-p-1023|proof|mystery,realist|A court sketch artist notices that an exhibit was drawn from a different viewing angle than any witness could have occupied. The artist who supplied the original sketch is also the person everyone trusted to preserve the scene accurately.

wd-p-1024|route|realist,adventure|A courier must carry a fragile repair part through a building whose elevators use vibration-sensitive brakes. Walking avoids the vibration but would reach the machine after the automatic shutdown closes its access compartment.

wd-p-1025|recognition|realist,family|A child gives every adult at a gathering a drawing of a different helpful act. One adult receives a blank page and discovers it is an invitation to choose what they want to be remembered for next.

wd-p-1026|classification|speculative,political|A public service assigns priority using the age of a problem's first report. A resident discovers that routine updates have repeatedly opened new files, making the longest-unresolved cases appear newly arrived and least urgent.

wd-p-1027|craft|realist,mystery|A ceramicist finds that a supposedly accidental crack follows a line drawn under the glaze. The line marks a concealed alteration to the object's shape, and the customer requesting repair wants the crack preserved rather than closed.

wd-p-1028|care|realist,romance|A person arranges quiet companionship for a grieving partner by asking friends to visit without mentioning the loss. The partner begins to feel that everyone has forgotten, forcing the organizer to reveal the instruction without making the visits seem staged.

wd-p-1029|maintenance|speculative,adventure|A settlement's warning lights run on motion generated by people crossing a public walkway. An evacuation order clears the walkway just when the lights must remain on to guide the last residents out.

wd-p-1030|interpretation|mystery,family|A family's old home movies contain repeated shots of a closed door. The camera operator explains that the door, not the people in frame, marked whether a relative had agreed to be included in the family's account of that year.

wd-p-1031|choice|realist,satire|A club offers an award for the most practical suggestion without requiring implementation. The winning idea is to stop holding suggestion competitions, and presenting the prize requires deciding whether to carry out the recommendation immediately.

wd-p-1032|threshold|speculative,adventure|A ship can pass through a protective field only if every passenger has declared a destination. One passenger does not know where home is, and inventing an address would send the navigation system somewhere nobody can safely reach.

wd-p-1033|learning|realist,family|An adult asks a parent to teach a practical skill and receives the same instructions that caused arguments in childhood. This time the adult understands the method well enough to explain exactly which unspoken step was missing.

wd-p-1034|ownership|realist,political|A neighborhood's shared meeting room is booked in the name of whoever holds its key. A helpful resident copies the key for emergencies, and the booking office treats the copies as competing claims to the room.

wd-p-1035|resources|realist,romance|A couple has saved enough for one person's extended leave. The person who needs rest now is not the person for whom the money was originally set aside, and using it requires revisiting whether savings belong to a purpose or a partnership.

wd-p-1036|repair|speculative,family|A house repairs damage according to the oldest resident's memory of its layout. An adult returning home finds new accessibility changes repeatedly undone overnight, and asks the family to teach the house a present it has never learned to remember.

wd-p-1037|sequence|mystery,realist|A receipt places a suspect at a shop after closing, but its number fits an earlier transaction. The shopkeeper reused blank receipt books during a system failure, and the missing original would reveal what was bought before the alleged alibi.

wd-p-1038|access|realist,political|A public performance reserves accessible seating until a deadline, then sells unused spaces. A patron receives a late confirmation because the accessible booking line was closed during the same hours the general box office stayed open.

wd-p-1039|identity|speculative,romance|A couple can choose one shared appearance for a ceremonial visit to another world. Their disagreement reveals that each has imagined presenting the relationship through qualities the other does not want made representative.

wd-p-1040|coordination|realist,adventure|A flood team lowers supplies from a bridge using a rope that also marks the safe limit for rescuers below. A volunteer shortens it to speed deliveries, unknowingly moving the boundary the next boat will trust.

wd-p-1041|value|realist,family|A relative offers to buy a family object for more than its market value to keep it close. The seller needs the money but worries that accepting would turn a shared memory into evidence of a debt within the family.

wd-p-1042|consent|realist,satire|A town offers a prize for the most welcoming house, judged by surprise visits. The finalist who asks judges to make an appointment is praised for honesty but told that boundaries conflict with the competition's definition of welcome.

wd-p-1043|proof|mystery,realist|A surveyor notices that a photographed measuring tape begins at a folded section rather than zero. Correcting the length explains a disputed boundary, but the fold also identifies the person who lent the supposedly unfamiliar tool.

wd-p-1044|route|speculative,adventure|A traveler follows a road that exists only while someone expects their arrival. At the final junction, the host falls asleep, leaving a companion to sustain an expectation without knowing the traveler's true destination.

wd-p-1045|recognition|realist,romance|A partner commissions a song based on memories collected from friends. Its chorus celebrates a choice the subject regrets, and responding honestly means separating affection for the gift from agreement with the story it tells.

wd-p-1046|classification|realist,political|A city distinguishes urgent repairs from improvements by whether the broken feature appears on the original plan. Residents who added safety adaptations themselves cannot obtain repairs because the features were never officially recorded as necessary.

wd-p-1047|craft|speculative,mystery|A bookbinder stitches pages so that a hidden story appears only as the book wears out. A collector wants the book preserved unread, while a researcher needs the damage that will make its missing testimony legible.

wd-p-1048|care|realist,family|A family member begins hosting gatherings so a long-time host can rest. The old host keeps arriving early to help because the work was also the role through which she knew how to belong.

wd-p-1049|maintenance|realist,adventure|A rescue team follows temporary lights powered by individual timers. The installer set each for the same duration rather than the same end time, and the path will darken from the far end before anyone expects it.

wd-p-1050|interpretation|speculative,political|A civic archive stores agreements as the emotions participants felt when signing. A mediator discovers that fear and relief look identical in the official display, making coerced agreement indistinguishable from a welcomed compromise.

wd-p-1051|choice|realist,romance|Two people agree to revisit a difficult decision only when both feel ready. Each later says they have been waiting for the other to ask, revealing that the considerate rule has allowed the decision to remain untouched indefinitely.
